name: kanca-word-game
description: Kanca - Word Game: Türkçe-İngilizce çengel bulmaca, iOS ve Android için Capacitor ile paketlenir

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
